The indirect pathway through Cefotetan and Meclocycline further supports a potential role of Demeclocycline in combating S. aureus, though the direct mechanism remains unclear. The scores from the paths indicate a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, but the evidence is not yet robust enough to definitively establish a causal link.
